title: Ops & Tribes Weekly Handoff — 2026-08-05
agenda: Canary rollout metrics and next steps
Dedicated capacity promo and customer impact
notes:
Round-robin: short updates.
- Serving Runtime (Diego): canary of 2.1 kernel selection landed; latency p50 down ~6% but one perf regression on long-history sequences — PLAT-4821 assigned. Working hypothesis: kernel fallback path for 32k context triggers extra memcpy.
- Private Deployments (Priya): early pilot with regulated customer in EMEA delayed by networking certs; holding pattern on on-prem installer until security review complete.
- Console & Rollouts (Ethan): rollout pipeline supports per-customer fallback policy; observed 2 fallback events this week that exposed a missing metric for model-variant selection. Adding tracing span.
- SRE (Sofia): two incidents (short outage to Dedicated pool) — root cause: autoscaler concurrency bug + Azure spot preemption pattern. Mitigations in progress; postmortem draft linked.
- Observability (Liam): new token-level breakdown landed in staging, sampling is still noisy for embeddings-heavy keys; need help from ops to tune agent config.
- Solutions (Maya): customer demo templates updated to highlight cost controls (Optimize suggestions). Need clearer guidance around quantization tradeoffs for Q&A during demos.

Deep dives:
1) Canary rollback criteria (Ethan): propose codifying SLO triggers + signal thresholds (latency > 2x baseline p95 OR error rate +1%) to auto-pause. Discussion: agree to formalize but keep manual override. Action: Ethan to draft policy doc.
2) KV cache regression (Diego + Liam): intermittent GC pauses and copy-on-write hotspots during long-history streams. Quick mitigation: pin larger pages on problematic nodes and increase cache eviction frequency. Long term: instrument per-request KV usage and add targeted cache warming.

Parking lot / questions to surface:
- Should Dedicated customers be able to opt into aggressive prefetching cache policy? (privacy/footprint concerns)
- Timeline for making per-route cost breakdown GA? (marketing tied)

Notes-to-self: capture sample traces for PLAT-4821 and attach to jira. Add a short FAQ for sales re: Dedicated incident implications.
decisions: Adopt conservative automatic canary pause rule (Ethan to draft specifics)
Apply temporary pinning on nodes experiencing KV cache regression while long-term fix proceeds
Delay GA for per-route cost breakdown until sampling noise reduced
